title: Grammar deps + adapter scaffold + registry wiring
description:
Bootstrap JS/TS language support infrastructure. Add tree-sitter grammar crates, create stub parser modules, wire adapter structs into the registry.

Key decisions already made:
- Two tree-sitter crates: `tree-sitter-javascript` and `tree-sitter-typescript` (TS crate provides both TypeScript and TSX grammars)
- Two adapters: `JsAdapter` (extensions: .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs) and `TsAdapter` (extensions: .ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts)  
- Two parser modules: `src/parser/javascript.rs` and `src/parser/typescript.rs`
- JS adapter uses `tree_sitter_javascript::LANGUAGE` grammar
- TS adapter uses `tree_sitter_typescript::LANGUAGE_TYPESCRIPT` for .ts/.mts/.cts and `tree_sitter_typescript::LANGUAGE_TSX` for .tsx (design note: may need separate TsxAdapter if grammar dispatch can't be extension-conditional — resolve during implementation)
- Both adapters return `ModuleBoundaryStrength::Moderate` (file = module in ES modules, similar to Dart)

Files to touch:
- `Cargo.toml` — add tree-sitter-javascript and tree-sitter-typescript deps
- `src/parser/mod.rs` — add `pub mod javascript; pub mod typescript;`
- `src/parser/javascript.rs` — create with stub `parse()` returning empty ParseResult
- `src/parser/typescript.rs` — create with stub `parse()` calling through to JS parse
- `src/parser/adapter.rs` — add JsAdapter + TsAdapter structs implementing LanguageAdapter, register in default_registry()

Reference: follow the pattern established by PythonAdapter/CAdapter — unit struct, LanguageAdapter impl, no FcaAttributeSource yet (added in integration phase).

acceptance_criteria.text: cargo build succeeds with new grammar crates linked
parse() on both adapters returns an empty-but-valid ParseResult (no panic, parsed_ok reflects tree-sitter result)
module_boundary_hints() returns Moderate for both adapters

decisions.decision: TsAdapter uses LANGUAGE_TSX grammar for all extensions
decisions.rationale: TSX grammar is a strict superset of TS — regular TS parses correctly. Avoids needing per-extension grammar dispatch which the LanguageAdapter trait doesn't support (grammar() has no file context). If distinct grammars become necessary, the trait can be extended later.
decisions.rejected_alternative: Two separate language_ids (typescript/typescriptreact) with separate pool entries — adds complexity for no benefit at the scaffold stage

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Codex adversarial review: no findings specific to the scaffold/adapter task. TS stub producing empty symbols noted but accepted — adapter registration is fine since the arc won't be used until TS extraction lands.
